title: UniFi Protect Retention Below Target
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=unifiprotect:event event=storage
| stats latest(retention_days) as retention_days by nvr
| where retention_days<7
| sort retention_days
description: Uses UniFi Protect storage telemetry telemetry to monitor remaining retention window for recordings in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for NVR storage that is no longer meeting your retention goal, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest UniFi Protect storage telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: NVR table of retention days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It totals remaining retention window for recordings so you can spot NVR storage that is no longer meeting your retention goal before it becomes annoying.
